SCREENS.name: Application Entry
SCREENS.purpose: Splash/loading state, localization initialization, guest access and app configuration.
SCREENS.dependencies: Precedes every customer screen; feeds locale to the whole app.
acceptance: App opens to splash in under 2s on mid-range devices
Guest access lands on C-01 homepage
Locale (AR/EN + RTL) applied before first content screen
frontend: Request config, apply locale and theme (AR/EN, RTL/LTR)
Cache last good config for offline starts
Route to C-01 or C-07 based on session
backend: Serve lightweight config endpoint (feature flags, versions)
No personal data returned without auth

SCREENS.name: Homepage
SCREENS.purpose: Marketplace storefront: featured phones, new/used sections, brands, verified-store highlights.
validation: Empty search → no-op or focus C-02
SCREENS.dependencies: C-00 config; published listings (M-07/M-08) and verified stores (M-04).
acceptance: Guest sees populated home with real published data
Every card navigates to the right screen
Pull-to-refresh works
frontend: Compose sections from home API response
backend: Aggregate home payload efficiently (single call preferred)
Only return published listings & verified stores

SCREENS.name: Search & Filters
SCREENS.purpose: Find phones by keyword, brand/model, price range, condition, storage and specs; sort & paginate results.
ui: Filter sheet (brand, price, condition, storage, specs)
SCREENS.dependencies: C-03 for details; published listings from M-07/M-08.
acceptance: Filters compose together correctly (AND semantics)
Pagination stable under filter changes
Empty state suggests removing filters
backend: Search adapter with filters, sorting, pagination

SCREENS.name: Product Details
SCREENS.purpose: Show a single listing: gallery, price, specs, condition, seller info, and paths to contact or compare.
SCREENS.dependencies: C-04, C-05, C-06 navigation; M-13 publication states.
acceptance: All listing states handled with clear messages
Failed gallery images show placeholder, never break layout
Used listing shows condition, battery health, defects & real photos
frontend: Render product gallery with lazy images and failure fallback
backend: Return published listing and related product information
Handle deleted, suspended or unavailable listings with proper status codes

SCREENS.name: Store Profile
SCREENS.purpose: Public face of a verified phone store: identity, location, contacts and current inventory.
SCREENS.dependencies: C-03, C-05; M-04 verification status; M-11 store settings.
acceptance: Verification badge reflects real backend status
Suspended store shows friendly notice, not broken page
In-store search filters only that store
backend: Scope inventory query to the store

SCREENS.name: Contact Seller
SCREENS.purpose: Reach the store through available contact methods (phone or supported external messaging).
SCREENS.permissions: Contact info only served for listings that allow it; never raw merchant PII dumps.
SCREENS.dependencies: C-03/C-04 entry; M-11 store contact settings.
acceptance: Only methods the store enabled are shown
Unavailable methods show helpful message
Works for guests where store allows it
frontend: Render method cards with deep links (tel:, messaging apps)
backend: Serve permitted contact methods per listing/store

SCREENS.name: Compare Offers
SCREENS.purpose: Compare multiple listings of the same product variant across stores: price, condition, availability.
responses: All published listings for the variant with price, condition, availability, store summary
SCREENS.dependencies: C-03 entry point; consistent product variant matching (M-06).
acceptance: Same-variant listings only — no cross-model mixing
Cheapest & best-condition highlighted
Empty compare shows gentle empty state
frontend: Deep link each offer to C-03

SCREENS.name: Customer Account
SCREENS.purpose: Registration/login where needed, profile, account recovery and session management.
responses: Error codes for each failure mode
SCREENS.permissions: Account owner only for profile actions.
SCREENS.dependencies: C-00 config; guest browsing works without an account where allowed.
acceptance: Register → login → recovery all work in both languages
Sessions expire safely and re-authenticate cleanly
Guests are never blocked from browsing

SCREENS.name: Saved Listings
SCREENS.purpose: Let signed-in customers bookmark products and manage them later.
interactions: Handle listing that no longer exists
responses: Saved listing summaries with availability flag
SCREENS.dependencies: C-07 auth; C-03 save action. Future feature — not MVP.
acceptance: Saves persist across devices after login
Removed listings show "no longer available", never error
backend: Availability flag computed at read time

SCREENS.name: Loading, Empty & Offline States
SCREENS.purpose: Reusable interface states applied across all customer screens — not an independent screen.
interactions: Dismiss offline banner when back online
SCREENS.permissions: Applies to every screen per its own rules.
states: Offline — this screen IS the states
SCREENS.dependencies: Used by C-01…C-08, C-10.
acceptance: Every screen has all four states designed & implemented
Retry actually re-fetches
Offline cache never shows stale prices as current
frontend: Shared state components (skeleton, empty, error, offline)
Consistent friendly copy in AR & EN
backend: Predictable error schema so the app can map codes to states

SCREENS.name: Categories & Brands
SCREENS.purpose: Browse the catalog by brand or category and jump to relevant listings.
SCREENS.dependencies: C-02 for results.
acceptance: Counts match reality
Brands with zero listings hidden or marked

SCREENS.name: Merchant Registration
SCREENS.purpose: Create the merchant account: required fields, validation and confirmation.
SCREENS.permissions: Public registration; merchant role assigned on creation.
SCREENS.dependencies: Starts the M-01→M-04 verification path toward M-05.
acceptance: Registration works in AR & EN with RTL
Duplicate accounts get a clear message
Account exists but is unverified — cannot publish
backend: Merchant account creation with unique constraints

SCREENS.name: Business Information
SCREENS.purpose: Capture the store identity: name, business location, contact details and owner information.
SCREENS.dependencies: M-01; feeds M-03 evidence submission.
acceptance: Draft saves without losing data on refresh
Name conflicts flagged immediately

SCREENS.name: Business Verification
SCREENS.purpose: Upload verification evidence, meet requirements, and submit the application for review.
validation: All required documents present before submit
SCREENS.permissions: Authenticated merchant, own store. Documents are access-restricted after upload.
SCREENS.dependencies: M-02 data; reviewed in A-02/A-03/A-04.
acceptance: Documents only accessible to authorized reviewers
Cannot submit with missing required evidence
Upload failures are retryable
backend: Secure document storage (private bucket, signed access)
Application state machine: draft → submitted → pending

SCREENS.name: Verification Status
SCREENS.purpose: Show where the store stands: pending, approved, rejected or changes-requested.
SCREENS.dependencies: A-04 decisions drive this state; gating for M-05+.
acceptance: Every state clearly communicated with next action
Changes-requested shows exactly what to fix
Approved stores immediately gain publishing rights
frontend: Deep-link to the exact form section to fix

SCREENS.name: Merchant Dashboard
SCREENS.purpose: Home for the verified store: listing summaries, store status, low-stock indicators and key actions.
ui: Listing summary cards (active, drafts, pending, out of stock)
SCREENS.permissions: Verified merchant or authorized staff member.
SCREENS.dependencies: M-04 approval gate; aggregates M-09/M-13 data.
acceptance: Unverified store sees verification guidance instead of tools
Numbers match the inventory screens

SCREENS.name: Create Listing — Select Type
SCREENS.purpose: Choose brand & model from the catalog, match the product variant, and pick new vs used.
validation: Variant must exist (request addition if missing)
SCREENS.dependencies: Entry to M-07 (new) and M-08 (used); catalog managed by platform.
acceptance: Branch to new vs used form is explicit
Missing model has a "request addition" path

SCREENS.name: New Phone Listing Form
SCREENS.purpose: Publish an offer for new stock: quantity-based with uniform specifications.
acceptance: Quantity decrements as stock sells (no per-unit condition)
Draft never lost on refresh
backend: New listing = single record + quantity inventory

SCREENS.name: Used Phone Listing Form
SCREENS.purpose: Publish an individual used device: unique condition, battery health, accessories, defects and real photos.
SCREENS.dependencies: M-06 branch; different business rules than M-07.
acceptance: Used listing is quantity 1 — one unit, one record
Buyer sees condition, battery health & defects on C-03
Stock photos forbidden — actual photos enforced by policy
backend: Used listing = individual inventory unit with condition data
Listing removed automatically when unit sold

SCREENS.name: Inventory Management
SCREENS.purpose: View, search, edit, deactivate and manage all store listings in one place.
responses: Paginated own listings with states & stock
SCREENS.permissions: Verified merchant / authorized staff, own store only.
SCREENS.dependencies: M-07/M-08 for editing; M-13 states.
acceptance: Every M-13 state visible & correct
Edits preserve publication rules

SCREENS.name: Price & Stock Updates
SCREENS.purpose: Fast adjustments: quick price edits, quantity changes, validation and update feedback.
SCREENS.dependencies: M-09 table; backend price history.
acceptance: Price change recorded in history
Concurrent edits detected, never silently overwritten
frontend: Inline editors with optimistic UI + rollback

SCREENS.name: Store Settings
SCREENS.purpose: Manage store description, locations, contacts, profile images and staff access.
SCREENS.dependencies: Feeds public C-04/C-05 data.
acceptance: Contact toggles instantly reflected on customer side
Staff can be limited to inventory-only access

SCREENS.name: Advertisement Management
SCREENS.purpose: Create promotional campaigns: placements, audiences, schedule, approval and results.
SCREENS.permissions: Verified merchant; campaigns require admin approval.
SCREENS.dependencies: A-08 review; C-01 placements. FUTURE FEATURE — not MVP.
acceptance: No campaign runs without approval
Results reflect real placements

SCREENS.name: Listing Publication Status
SCREENS.purpose: Communicate every listing lifecycle state and what the merchant can do in each.
SCREENS.dependencies: Used across M-07…M-12; driven by backend workflow & A-05 moderation.
acceptance: Merchant always knows why a listing is not public
Rejected listings can be corrected without starting over
backend: Publication state machine with audited transitions

SCREENS.name: Administrative Overview
SCREENS.purpose: Operational pulse: metrics, verification queues, moderation queues and alerts.
SCREENS.dependencies: Aggregates A-02/A-05/A-07 activity.
acceptance: Metrics match queue screens
Alerts actionable

SCREENS.name: Store Verification Queue
SCREENS.purpose: Work through new applications, pending decisions and re-verification cases.
SCREENS.dependencies: M-03 submissions arrive here; A-03/A-04 decisions.
acceptance: No application can be lost or stuck invisibly
Assignment recorded in audit
backend: Assignment & state transitions with audit events

SCREENS.name: Review Store Evidence
SCREENS.purpose: Inspect submitted evidence in a restricted-access view and record reviewer notes.
SCREENS.permissions: Administrator with verification scope; access logged; evidence never downloaded unlogged.
SCREENS.dependencies: A-02 queue; feeds A-04.
acceptance: Every document access is audited
Notes persist per case

SCREENS.name: Verification Decision
SCREENS.purpose: Approve, reject or request corrections with recorded reasons and audit events.
validation: Dual approval needed for reversal cases
SCREENS.permissions: Administrator with verification scope; critical reversals need dual approval (A-07).
SCREENS.dependencies: A-03 notes; triggers M-04 state change via backend workflow (NOT by admin logging into merchant UI).
acceptance: Merchant sees decision & reason in M-04
Decision & actor recorded in audit log
Backend state change — no admin session in merchant portal

SCREENS.name: Listing Moderation
SCREENS.purpose: Inspect reports, remove listings, suspend or restore content and record decisions.
SCREENS.dependencies: Affects M-13 merchant states & public visibility on C-01/C-02.
acceptance: Suspended listing disappears from public search instantly
Merchant sees suspension reason in M-13
Every action audited

SCREENS.name: Roles & Permissions
SCREENS.purpose: Manage authorized staff, store memberships and administrative access.
SCREENS.dependencies: Dual approval via A-07.
acceptance: No single founder can silently grant critical access
Role changes take effect immediately
frontend: Role matrix UI with dual-approval badges

SCREENS.name: Audit Logs & Dual Approval
SCREENS.purpose: Review sensitive changes and independently approve especially critical founder operations.
interactions: Approve or reject pending critical operation
SCREENS.dependencies: Consumes audit events from A-04/A-05/A-06 and backend actions.
acceptance: Every sensitive action traceable to an actor & timestamp
Critical operations blocked until second founder approves

SCREENS.name: Advertisement Review
SCREENS.purpose: Review merchant campaigns, validate placements and approve or reject them.
SCREENS.permissions: Administrator with advertising scope. FUTURE FEATURE.
SCREENS.dependencies: M-12 submissions; C-01 placements. Not MVP.
acceptance: Approved campaigns only appear on enabled placements

SCREENS.name: Platform Announcements
SCREENS.purpose: Create announcements targeted at merchants, customers or other authorized audiences.
SCREENS.permissions: Administrator with announcements scope. FUTURE FEATURE.
SCREENS.dependencies: Shown in M-05 (merchant) area. Not MVP.
acceptance: Only selected audience sees the announcement

MILESTONES.completion: Both founders sign off on MVP scope and out-of-scope list.

MILESTONES.description: Map every customer, merchant and admin journey to concrete screens.
MILESTONES.completion: Every user goal is covered by at least one screen; IDs agreed.

MILESTONES.completion: Architecture reviewed and approved by both founders.
